item.name: 31 - Place Not In Any Trip Filter

exec: pm.test('A place with a trip visit is excluded', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(p => p.id)).to.not.include(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_place_id'))));
pm.test('History has the visit and the stay', () => { pm.expect(j.visits.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.stays.length).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Itinerary has the visit', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.visits.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.hidden_visit_count).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('Not stamped outside the trip dates', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().tags).to.eql([]));
pm.test('Shared charge counted once in the total', () => { pm.expect(j.total.total_eur).to.eql('25.50'); pm.expect(j.total.transaction_count).to.eql(2); });
pm.test('Grouped by kind', () => { const kinds = j.by_kind.map(k => k.kind); pm.expect(kinds).to.include.members(['flight', 'lodging']); });
pm.test('The stay still needs a grade and notes', () => { const stay = j.to_complete.find(i => i.kind === 'stay'); pm.expect(stay.missing).to.eql(['grade', 'notes']); });
pm.test('The graded visit is complete and a highlight', () => { pm.expect(j.to_complete.find(i => i.kind === 'visit')).to.eql(undefined); pm.expect(j.highlights[0].grade).to.eql(5); });

pm.test('Pins listed', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.points).to.be.an('array'); j.points.forEach(p => { pm.expect(p.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p.address).to.be.a('string'); }); });
